hormuz.label: Strait of Hormuz closes
hormuz.summary: LNG supply shock lifts European gas prices
hormuz.explanation: GB price up £18.6/MWh: gas up 40% sets the price in 64% of hours (+£16), less spare French nuclear to import (+£3).

interconnector_trip.label: Norway link trips
interconnector_trip.summary: North Sea Link to Blyth goes offline
interconnector_trip.explanation: GB price up £9.7/MWh: 1.3 GW of Norwegian hydro replaced by gas at the margin (+£8), more pull on French links (+£2).

nuclear_outage.label: French nuclear outage
nuclear_outage.explanation: FR price up €26/MWh: residual load up 5 GW pushes gas to the margin (+€21), exports to GB fall (+€5).

scottish_storm.label: Storm over Scotland
scottish_storm.summary: Gusts lift Scottish wind; boundaries saturate
scottish_storm.explanation: GB price down £12.9/MWh: wind up 35% (−£15) but 18 GWh paid to switch off behind the B6 boundary (+£2).
